items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: Mac Shann (phonetic) would give us the first chorus and turn us a'loose, you know.

ctx.x: And this is how we outblew them
all the time, 'cause they were playing arrangements, and Mac Shann (phonetic) would give us the first chorus and turn us a'loose, you know.
Well, when did you get with Mac Shann, then?
